uncertainties: Original embedded icons are raster assets; their traced vector contours remain approximations.
Tiny decorative icon lettering is rebuilt as editable text and differs in typeface.
Existing layout and body typography are retained for comparison; this is not an independent full-layout reconstruction.
Screenshot-only fallback is separately tested on four objects, not validated for all figures.
revisionNotes: V2 includes library asset selection, vector normalization and provenance, cleaned local tracing, and renewed whole/detail review.
Reviewed context fill changed from flat color to a continuous gradient; subtle title shadows restored.
This is a full workflow iteration, not an icon-only controlled benchmark.
